findings_repaired.honesty: Paseo's config.systemPrompt is creation-only and no route reads it back. The record therefore says delivery = create_only_no_readback, and CoreTeamSeatPersonaDto is deliberately NOT a field of CoreTeamNativeSeatDto, which reports runtime readback. Request construction is not presented as readback.
findings_repaired.repair: New immutable per-occupancy table hosted_seat_role_personas, written BEFORE the native call beside the launch intent, so a launch whose acknowledgement is lost still leaves behind what it was going to deliver. Keyed by (project_id, seat_binding_id, occupancy_generation) so a replacement freezes its own row instead of overwriting the predecessor's. kontor_core::spec::RolePersonaSnapshot carries the exact delivered text plus a SHA-256 of those bytes; the same value is persisted and delivered, so recorded-as-received cannot drift from sent.
findings_repaired.subject: TEST-007's non-null run-snapshot persona contract
findings_repaired.surface_interpretation: TEST-007 says 'run snapshot'. The LSA is a hosted topology seat keyed by SeatBindingId and has no AgentRun, so a run snapshot is not a surface it has. Implemented on the seat snapshot, which the report's own wording ('run/seat snapshot contract') permits. Flagged for the re-verifier as the one interpretive decision taken.

findings_repaired.placement: Added to the existing regression a_promotion_creates_one_epic_and_hands_the_work_to_its_lsa as instructed, not as a disconnected mutant-only test.
findings_repaired.repair: The promotion regression previously replaced only a TPM, which seeds no persona, so dropping the successor's role prompt changed nothing observable. It now also re-routes the LSA, a role that does have a configured persona, and asserts the successor's system prompt separately from initialPrompt. A new hosted_initial_prompt accessor on the runtime fake makes the two values independently readable, so a successor launched with the handoff in both slots fails.
